chips.reasoning: NVDA +3% on the day, no dated NVDA catalyst in the record; sector flat over 20 days. No concrete reason beyond a coin flip.

pharma.reasoning: LLY near its high after the Q2 beat; headlines are policy noise with no drug-specific news. Already priced in.

copper_uranium.reasoning: FCX +13.5% in 20 days, copper near record, Congo supply headline is commentary only. Priced in; no dated catalyst.
